name: Hydraulic power unit
function: The pump, reservoir, and filtration that supply hydraulic pressure to the valve actuators on the tree and manifold.

tabs.overview: Diesel or electric driven; supply pressure per the actuator design; filtered, with a reservoir sized for all actuators. Mounted on the manifold skid or on its own skid outside the red zone.
tabs.engineering: Hydraulic components rated above the actuator supply pressure; fluid per the actuator OEM.
tabs.safety: Hydraulic leaks near the tree are not repaired under pressure; the unit is shut down and the circuit bled.
tabs.evidence: API 6A (S1) for pressure-containing parts and connections; public OEM pages (S2, S3, S5, S11, S12) for configurations; field and manufacturing practice (S9).

hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.
